descriptionChirho: Proper noun referring to Amalek, the eponymous ancestor of the Amalekites or the Amalekite nation/people collectively. All seven sense clusters represent the same referent with purely morphological and syntactic variation: bare nominative, with conjunction, with various prepositions (b-, l-, min-), and with the article. Spanish 'Amalec/Amaleq,' Hindi 'amalek,' Arabic 'amaliq,' Korean 'amallek,' Swahili 'Amaleki/Waamaleki' all consistently render the same proper noun across all syntactic contexts without any semantic differentiation.
